comment: Capability labels and status meanings for the Controller web Library and `vonkctl recipe detail`. `vocabulary` is a hand-kept excerpt in the contract's published shape (only the entries the cases use), so a newer release never turns a test red. The web test renders each case under that vocabulary and compares the capability chips' text and titles and the status badge title; the vonkctl test renders the same input and compares the printed `Usage` and `Meaning` lines. Both must equal the literals here exactly. A capability the release does not list shows its name; none declared shows `Not reported`.
